description: This is a Perl test script for the lighttpd web server, specifically testing HTTP request handling, response generation, and various HTTP features such as headers, status codes, authentication, and proxy behavior.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A test harness class for controlling and interfacing with the lighttpd server during tests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the LightyTest class.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Starts the lighttpd server process with the specified configuration.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Stops the running lighttpd server process.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request to the server and retrieves the response for testing.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.description: Checks if the server or build environment supports certain features, such as zlib.
